svg.title: Haptic Force-Cepx hardware: printed mechanism and T-Knob actuation
svg.desc: Separated CAD study of the supplied finger ring, moving grip, T-Knob motor and board module, and motor holder. Shapes and relative sizes are from STEP files, with display offsets rather than validated assembly mates. A separate block diagram explains the functional sensing and actuation loop.
svg.text: Transfers grip motion and resistive feedback.
Integrates the BLDC motor, encoder, controller,
Supports the motor module and grip mechanism.
